in_marathi.name: Ansu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ansu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Ansu is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Anus’, which means ‘drop’ or ‘sweat’. This name is believed to be associated with Lord Indra, the God of Rain, Thunder, and Lightning. In Hindu scriptures, Anus is mentioned as the sweat droplets that fall from the God Indra's body while he is engrossed in his divine duties.
